text.tspan: TCP · curl to a web server on port 8080
FIN, then ACK + FIN in one packet, then ACK
1 packet: the sender can't tell if it arrived
Reliable: lost data re-sent, order kept, no duplicates
No guarantees: arrives once or not at all, any order
No flow control: the app must be careful
DNS (mostly), DHCP, NTP, voice and video calls,
